commit.message:
funding: release fundee reservation on early returns

fundeeProcessOpenChannel creates the wallet reservation before it
finishes validating the open_channel parameters, but only adds it to
activeReservations afterwards. failFundingFlow releases reservations
through activeReservations, so returns in between didn't release the
reservation.

Release the reservation directly on those returns, and add a test that
checks that no wallet reservation remains after the fundee declines a
channel.

lnwallet: guard ActiveReservations with limboMtx

ActiveReservations read fundingLimbo without holding limboMtx, while
the wallet's request handler mutates the map under that lock. Take the
read lock so callers can safely inspect the active reservations.

commit.message:
lnd: clamp max-commit-fee-rate-anchors to the fee rate ceiling

max-commit-fee-rate-anchors only had a lower bound. The value is
converted to sat/kw by multiplying it by 1000 and casting it to a
signed amount, so a huge value wraps around to a negative cap. With a
negative cap IdealCommitFeeRate falls back to the minimum relay fee,
the opposite of what the operator asked for.

Fee estimates are already capped at FeePerKwCeiling, so any cap above
it behaves like the ceiling. Clamp the option to the same 10000
sat/vbyte maximum the sweeper uses and warn, rather than failing
startup for configs that worked before.

lnd: clamp max-commit-fee-rate-anchors to the fee rate ceiling

max-commit-fee-rate-anchors only had a lower bound. The value is

commit.message:
lnwallet: reject fee updates below commit floor

IdealCommitFeeRate can return the absolute maximum fee rate below the
commitment fee floor when the initiator cannot afford the minimum.
UpdateFee accepted that result, allowing the link to send an update_fee
that commitment signing later rejected.

ReceiveUpdateFee had the same gap on the other side: it accepted an
update_fee below the floor from a non-conforming peer, and the next
commit_sig then failed the commitment sanity check and force closed the
channel.

Validate the lower bound in a shared validateFeeRateFloor helper, used
by both validateFeeRate and ReceiveUpdateFee. This rejects the update
before it enters the local or remote update log. Retain the commitment
sanity check as defense in depth, add regression tests for both
directions, and start TestReceiveUpdateFeeReplacement at the floor.

commit.message:
lnwire: preserve explicit gossip v2 default fields

Gossip v2 signatures cover the exact TLV records sent. Decoding
currently replaces absent fields with their defaults, while encoding
decides whether to include those fields from their values. As a result,
an explicitly encoded default is omitted when the message is re-encoded,
changing the signed byte stream.

Represent optional fields using OptionalRecordT and retain their
presence during decoding. Apply protocol defaults only through message
accessors, and emit every field that was present even when it contains
its default.

commit.message:
go: update btcwallet for sync-time reorgs

During synchronization, wallet transactions may be recorded ahead of
its sync tip. Ignoring a matching block disconnect can leave old history
in place when a replacement block arrives.

Update btcwallet and wtxmgr together to the merged fixes in btcwallet
PRs #1403 and #1404. The store enforces one block identity per height;
the wallet reconciles orphaned and canonical history atomically,
preserving canonical coinbase spend chains and notifying clients only
of real spentness changes after commit.

Both modules use upstream commit 16cfb4483d1f. The range from our prior
pin contains only these two fixes and their regression tests. No schema
migration is required; existing inconsistent history is not repaired.
